# Product vocabulary — Swarm and Lifecycle

When the user says **Swarm**, **Lifecycle**, **Life Cycle**, **LifeCycle**, or **Swarm/Lifecycle**, they are referring to the two product recaps in this repo. Read them before implementing related UX, data, or copy.

- **Swarm** (Foursquare Swarm): [`docs/references/swarm.md`](../../docs/references/swarm.md) — explicit check-ins, POI suggestions, stickers, mayorships, coins, friend activity, backfill.
- **Lifecycle** (Life Cycle by Sleep Cycle / Northcube): [`docs/references/lifecycle.md`](../../docs/references/lifecycle.md) — passive stay/time tracking, donut/pie recaps, place categories, reconstruct history after long inactivity.

How ThymeApp uses both, and what not to copy blindly: [`docs/references/README.md`](../../docs/references/README.md).

Screen specs: [`packages/mobile/src/SCREENS.md`](../../packages/mobile/src/SCREENS.md).
Stack: [`docs/TOOLING.md`](../../docs/TOOLING.md).
